Agreement.description:
The agreement with the provider's own totals (Claude Code's `cost-state`, the last record
of each root transcript): for each root session that has them and a message in the range,
the token sums of its messages inside the provider's window, main transcript and
sub-agents, against the provider's (#46).

The provider's window runs from when its counter started (`startTime`: the counter starts
again when a session is resumed in a new process) to the timestamp of the last record
before the `cost-state` line (records after it are not in it), both inclusive. A check
stored before the window was (#46) has an open window until `bosun reingest`.

A session is within the tolerance when `|transcripts - provider| * 100 <= tolerance *
provider` on the total of the four categories, and exceeds it when `(transcripts -
provider) * 100 > tolerance * provider`. The criterion is one-sided: the provider also
counts calls the transcripts never hold, so it may be larger ([`Undercount`]); the
transcripts may not. The categories are shown for reading.

The context curve per context window (#6): its prompt size at the start, its peak, and its

The prompt size of a message is `input + cache read + cache write 5 min + cache write 1 h`
of its usage. A compaction is a drop of the prompt size between consecutive messages of one
window (#3): `prompt(next) < prompt(previous)`, messages ordered by time, then id. Over the
messages of the scope only: a window's messages before the range are not seen.

longer names.

path.description:
Its root as configured, or the store's key of it when the configuration no longer
names it.

repo.description: `null` for messages whose working directory is in no configured repository.

by_category.description:
`total` by token category, in the order input, cache write 5 min, cache write 1 h,
cache read, output. The categories sum to `total` exactly.

by_kind.description:
`total` by the kind of the root session, `interactive` then `run`; both are always
present.

context.description: The context curve of each context window.

health.description: The ingest's counts and the agreement with the provider's own totals.

items.description:
The loop's sections (#72): items and attempts with their runs' exact cost, retries,
flaky verdicts, refused edits, time parked and the runs' commits. Their scope is said
in [`crate::Items`]; no other section includes them or is included in them.

old_method.description:
What the old method would have reported for the same messages, shown once next to
`total`.

per_commit.description: Eqv per commit, per repository, against the previous period.

reference_model.description: The model every eqv is measured against.

repo.description: The repository asked for; `null` for every message of the range.

total.description: The real total: every message of the scope, each counted once.

unpriced.description:
Models with no price at the time of some messages of the scope: their tokens are in
every count, their cost and eqv in none.

ReportParams.description: Params of `report.exact`: an identity, a half-open time range and an optional repository.

from_ms.description:
Messages at or after this time. The previous period of the per-commit trend is the
range of the same length that ends here.

repo.description:
A repository's name in the configuration: the sections of the range and repository
scope count its messages and commits only.

to_ms.description: Messages before this time. Must be after `from_ms`.

ResourceView.description: One resource instance and who holds it.

capacity.description: How many holders may hold it at once.

holders.description: Its holders: `item <id>`, `bosun with <pid>`, or [`BUSY`] for another identity's.

name.description: The instance: `<name>` for the machine scope, `<name>/<identity>`, `<name>/<repo>`.

resources.description: Every resource instance the identity can lease, by instance name.

worktrees.description:
The identity's worktrees that are `created` or `quarantined`, in the order they were
made.

item.description: The item id, `<repo>#<card>`; it must be in flight.

operator.description:
The operator token the daemon wrote at start (see [`crate::control`]). Missing, it is
refused like a wrong one.

label.description:
The label put on the card: the loop kills the session, takes a new snapshot and
starts again, then removes it (#5).

ResultCost.description:
The estimated cost of a set of tool results in the context.

For one call made by message `i` of a window, with `t = ceil(result_bytes /
bytes_per_token)`: the messages after `i` up to the first compaction after `i` (a drop of
the prompt size, as in [`crate::ContextCurve`]) carry the result. The first of them writes
it to the cache at its cache-write rate (the 1 h rate when that message wrote more 1 h than
5 min tokens, else the 5 min rate); each later one reads it at its cache-read rate:

`cost = t * write rate(i + 1) + sum over carrying messages j > i + 1 of t * cache read rate(j)`

A result with no message after it before a compaction costs nothing here.

carry_eqv.description: The cache reads after the first write, in eqv.

carry_turns.description:
The messages that read the results from the cache, summed over calls: how long they
stayed in context.

tokens.description: Their results' estimated tokens, `ceil(bytes / bytes_per_token)` per call, summed.

Resync.description: The params of an [`RESYNC`] notification: the subscriber missed events and is dropped.

head.description:
The sequence of the last event published when the subscriber was dropped. A client
that refetches its state after this has seen everything up to `head`.

ResyncReason.description: Why a client must refetch its state.

oneOf.description: The daemon no longer holds the sequence asked for: the ring moved past it.
The epoch asked for is not the daemon's: it restarted since.
The subscriber fell behind the ring while it was connected.

RetriedItem.description: An item that took more than one attempt.

RunCommit.description: A commit of a run, exactly linked.

session.description: The provider session id of the session that made it.

spawn.description: The session's number within the item.

trailers.description: Which of the daemon's trailers it carries.

base_sha.description: HEAD when it started and ended, once its range is recorded.

session.description: The provider session id bosun assigned.

spawn.description: The session's number within the item.

sums.description:
The messages of this spawn's session id. A resume shares the id of the session it
resumes, so its messages are counted once, under the first spawn of the id.

ScanState.description: The outcome of a repository's last commit scan.

oneOf.description: Not scanned since the daemon started.
Scanned; its commits are stored.
The scan failed; the commits stored before stay.

messages.description: Messages inside the provider's window over those windows.

windows.description:
Context windows with messages inside the provider's window: the main transcript and
each sub-agent.

SessionInfo.description: One session bosun spawned: in [`AttemptView::sessions`], and the result of `session.get`.

session.description: The provider session id bosun assigned (a resume keeps it).

spawn.description: The session's number within the item: the `spawn` of its events.

SessionParams.description: Params of `session.get`: exactly one of `session` and `item`.

item.description: An item id: its latest session.

session.description: A provider session id; with a resume, its latest spawn.

SessionRow.description:
One context window of `tokens.by_session`. A message counts in the window where it was
first seen. These fields are what `recount --compare` reads (shape version 1, #16).

agent.description: The sub-agent id; `null` for the session's main transcript.

SessionTail.description:
Result of `session.tail`: the item's output lines still in the identity's event ring, its
latest session and that session's context size.

The lines are contiguous: every `session_output` event of the item from the first one
returned up to `head` is in [`SessionTail::lines`]. A client that refetches after a resync
replaces what it showed with them and appends the events after `head`, with no gap.

context.description:
The context size of that session's main transcript, from the ingested transcript;
absent until a message of it is stored.

epoch.description: The daemon's epoch: the sequences are of this run of the daemon.

gap.description:
The ring no longer holds `from_seq`: lines after the client's last were dropped, and
`lines` are every line still held, as with no `from_seq`. The client replaces what it
showed with them rather than appending.

head.description: The sequence of the last event published when the lines were read; 0 before the first.

lines.description: The `session_output` events of the item, oldest first.

session.description: The item's latest session; absent before its first.

truncated.description: Earlier lines of the latest session are no longer held: the ring moved past them.

base_sha.description: The commit the item started from.

body.description: The normalised body the agent and the verdict were given.

branch.description: The branch HEAD was on at claim.

model.description:
The model its sessions ask for (`--model`): the card's, else the repository's default
(#133). Absent from a snapshot taken before it was recorded.

StreamStatus.description: Where an identity's event stream stands.

head.description: The sequence of the last event published; 0 before the first.

SubmitSummaryParams.description:
Params of `agent.submit_summary`. It may be called more than once; the last call of an
attempt wins.

epoch.description: The epoch of `from_seq`, as a previous [`SubscribeResult`] or [`Resync`] named it.

from_seq.description:
The first sequence wanted: one past the last the client has seen. Absent: only events
published from now on, with no replay.

epoch.description: The daemon's epoch: a reconnect names it with its `from_seq`.

head.description: The sequence of the last event published so far; 0 before the first.

resync.description:
Present when the events asked for are not held: the client refetches its state, and the
stream starts after `head`. Absent: the stream starts at `from_seq` (after `head` when
none was given), with no gap.

Tail.description: The live tail a subscription opted into.

item.description: The output of this item's sessions only; of every item when absent.

TailParams.description:
Params of `session.tail` (#74): the live tail of an item's sessions, as the daemon still
holds it.

from_seq.description:
Only the lines with this sequence or a later one: a client that has seen up to `n` asks
for `n + 1`. Absent: every line still held.

TokenSums.description:
Sums over a set of messages. Raw token counts are exact whatever the prices; the cost and
eqv cover the priced messages only.

cost.description: The cost of the priced messages, each at the price valid at its time.

eqv.description: `cost` in input-equivalent tokens of the reference model, rounded for display.

messages.description: API messages (distinct message ids), not transcript records.

unpriced_messages.description: Messages of a model with no price at their time: in the token counts, not in the cost.

TokensByModel.description: Result of `tokens.by_model`. Rows are sorted by model.

TokensByRepo.description: Result of `tokens.by_repo`. Rows are sorted by path, with `null` last.

TokensBySession.description: Result of `tokens.by_session`. Rows are sorted by session, then agent (`null` first).

TokensParams.description: Params of `tokens.*`: an identity and a half-open time range of message timestamps.

from_ms.description: Messages at or after this time; unbounded when absent.

to_ms.description: Messages before this time; unbounded when absent.

TokensSummary.description: What every `tokens.*` result holds besides its rows.

reference_model.description: The model every eqv is measured against.

unpriced.description: Models with no price at the time of some of their messages, by name.

errors.description: Calls whose result was an error.

TrailerMissing.description: A run's commit without some of the daemon's trailers.

Trailers.description: The daemon's trailers on a commit: present or not.

detail.description: The park reason, outcome or reason of `to`.

Trend.description: A period and the previous one.

Undercount.description:
The provider's excess over the transcripts (`-difference`), split by model kind: the
known undercount of the transcript method, which cannot see calls its transcripts never
hold. `absent_models + shared_models = provider.total - transcripts.total`.

Models are matched by name without a bracketed suffix: Claude Code's `[1m]` is a label.

absent_models.description:
The provider's total of the models the transcripts hold no message of inside the
window (side calls such as Haiku's).

shared_models.description:
The rest: the provider's total of the other models less the transcripts' total. It is
negative when the transcripts are larger on them.

UnpricedModel.description: A model with no price at the time of some messages.

command.description: The command that ran: the snapshot's verdict.

verdict_line.description: The line of the verdict's output that says what it found, if one did.

VersionRow.description: The counts of one parser version.

WaitingCard.description: A Ready card that is not claimed because a blocker of it is open (#5).

blockers.description: Its open blockers, in its `blocked-by` order.

WaitingFor.description: A full resource instance an item's request waits for, in `status.overview` and `item.get`.

Wide.description: A 64-bit unsigned count that may exceed 2^53, as a decimal string.

WindowCurve.description: One context window of [`ContextCurve`]: a session's main transcript or one sub-agent.

agent.description: The sub-agent id; `null` for the main transcript.

compactions.description: The drops of the prompt size between its consecutive messages.

peak.description: The largest prompt size of its messages in the scope.

start.description: The prompt size of the window's first message in the scope.

WorktreeUse.description: A worktree on disk or quarantined, with its size.

blocking.description: A quarantined worktree: the file that blocked its removal.

bytes.description: Its size on disk when it was last measured; `null` when it was never measured.

WorktreeView.description: A worktree on disk, or quarantined.

blocking.description: A quarantined worktree: the file that blocked its removal.

bytes.description: Its size on disk when it was last measured.

kind.description: `item` (the item's checkout) or `verdict` (a verdict's throwaway checkout).

description: Generated from the bosun-api crate by `cargo xtask gen-api`; do not edit. Transport: JSON-RPC 2.0, one message per line, on a Unix socket or a Windows named pipe.
title: bosun local API

agent.ask_question.description: Records a question of the agent with its attempt and HEAD. A blocking one sends the item to Needs you and ends the session after a short grace period; one that does not block goes into the item report.

agent.hello.description: The handshake of an agent session's `bosun-mcp`: what its credential is bound to. Refused for a credential that is not live or names another item.

agent.note.description: Records a note of the agent with its attempt and HEAD; it changes no state.

agent.submit_summary.description: Records the agent's summary with its attempt and HEAD; the last one of an attempt wins. It changes no state, whatever it says.

control.kill.description: The kill switch: every child is killed now, every item parks, and no further board write is made until it is released (`release`). Daemon-wide. Takes the operator token.

control.pause.description: Pauses one repository of the identity, or all of them: the current attempt finishes and no new session starts until resume. Takes the operator token.

control.resume.description: Lifts a pause by hand of one repository or of the identity; for a repository, also its automatic pause until the next interactive activity. Takes the operator token.

control.status.description: The control state of the identity and its repositories: the kill switch, pauses by hand and automatic ones, the daily cap, and the hold in force on each repository.

doctor.probe.description: Starts the daemon's `gh` once (`gh --version`) and says whether it ran: a daemon that cannot start children fails here (#131). Reads nothing of the identity's; needs no operator token.

events.subscribe.description: Subscribes to the identity's events from `from_seq` of `epoch`, or from now. The connection then carries the `events.event` and `events.resync` notifications in `x-notifications` and takes no more requests.

hello.description: The API version and the daemon's own version. The only method that names no identity.

ingest.reingest.description: Re-reads every transcript file of the identity from zero with the current parser, then reads the new commits of its repositories, and answers when both are done. Nothing is deleted.

ingest.status.description: The identity's transcript files, how far they are parsed, and the last ingest pass.

item.get.description: One item of the identity: its state, snapshot, transitions, attempts with their sessions and verdict runs, and its agents' calls.

item.restart.description: Restarts an item in flight: puts the `restart` label on its card, so the loop kills its session, takes a new snapshot and starts again. Refused while the kill switch is thrown. Takes the operator token.

lease.acquire.description: Asks for the leases of the named resources for a running process (a `bosun with` command): the first call files the request, later calls with the same pid and set report whether it is granted. Never says who holds a resource. Takes the operator token.

lease.list.description: The resource instances the identity can lease, with their holders and waiting requests, and its worktrees on disk or quarantined. Another identity's holder is shown only as `busy`.

lease.release.description: Releases what a process holds and withdraws its request; releasing nothing is not an error. Takes the operator token.

notify.channel.add.description: Adds a notification channel to the identity: its kind, non-secret parameters, events and      minimum gap in its database, its secret in the OS credential store under      `notify/<identity>/<name>`. The secret is in no row, log, error or result. Takes the      operator token.

notify.channel.list.description: The identity's live notification channels, each with its credential-store entry and      whether the entry is present, never the secret. Needs no operator token.

notify.channel.remove.description: Removes a notification channel of the identity: deletes its credential-store entry, then      marks its row removed. Takes the operator token.

notify.channel.test.description: Sends a test message on a notification channel of the identity now, outside any outbox,      and says whether its service accepted it. Takes the operator token.

queue.get.description: The board of one repository of the identity, or of each: its columns in board order, its hash, each card's state and snapshot hash, whether an edit waits for the next claim, and the lint findings of the cards in Ready.

queue.lint.description: The static lint of one card of a repository of the identity, read fresh from its board.

report.estimates.description: The estimate sections of the report over the range: the cost of tool results by tool and by file with cache carry, repeated reads of a file, and the cost of finding before a session's first write. Every number is an estimate and is never part of an exact total.

report.exact.description: The exact sections of the report over the range: eqv by category, model and session kind, eqv per commit against the previous period, the old method's number, the context curve per context window, and ingest health with the agreement with the provider's own totals. No estimate.

session.get.description: One session bosun spawned, by provider session id or by item (its latest), and whether it still runs: what `session tail` follows.

session.tail.description: The output lines of an item's sessions the daemon still holds, contiguous up to the stream's head, with the item's latest session and its context size: what a live tail refetches after a resync.

status.daemon.description: The daemon's version, process and start time, and whether it serves the identity.

status.overview.description: The Overview of the identity: per repository its state, the item in flight with its attempt and time in state, the last verdict, and the control state.

tokens.by_model.description: Token sums of the identity's messages in the range, per model.

tokens.by_repo.description: Token sums of the identity's messages in the range, per repository the working directory is in.

tokens.by_session.description: Token sums of the identity's messages in the range, per context window (a session's main transcript or one of its sub-agents).

tokens.pace.description: Eqv per minute over the last hour, the odometers of today and of this run of the daemon, and the reference pace with where it came from (the configured daily budget until limit windows are measured).

events.event.description: One event of the subscribed identity, in sequence order.

events.resync.description: The subscriber missed events: it refetches its state; the daemon closes the connection.
